title: Company Share Option Plan (CSOP): end of year return template, technical notes and guidance notes
text:
To complete your end of year template for a Company Share Option Plan ( CSOP ) (also known as EMI2) either:

 • use HMRC’s end of year return template

 • create your own template using the technical notes

 Use the guidance notes to help you fill in specific sections of the template.

 Check that you’re using the correct template for the tax year you’re submitting a return for. If you don’t use the correct template, it will not be processed correctly through the employment related securities online service and may result in delays.

 After completing your template, you can:

 • avoid delays in your submissions by checking your files for formatting errors 

 • submit your return
changeNote: Added the new end of year template, guidance notes and technical notes for April 2027.
